decisions.reason: After four years its active development has likely resolved into a stable feature, and the low maintenance cost still justifies keeping the charting option as part of the platform.
Mobile usability remains a strategic priority, and this component is likely embedded in the firm's core web mapping offer, so its option value persists.
As the flagship platform and stated focus of the firm's direction, its option value and centrality make withdrawal highly unlikely.
The mobile field data capture software has not shown enough observable traction after four years, and the option's value is now too low to justify continued investment.
